comment: Synthetic asymmetric decks (see corpus_live.rs 'Asymmetric synthetic decks' section): every stamping element + combinations in deliberately asymmetric configurations, live-compared against the pinned oracle by asymmetric_cases_match_oracle. selected_elements = the elements whose YPrim blocks are compared directly (the transposed-stamp catch). kind uses the same tolerance classes as solvable_now (micro|feeder|large). Cases with pending=true cover features the port does not implement yet (absorbed from the former gaps/ staging family, GAPS_PLAN.md section 3.1): the gate asserts the Rust engine errors loudly on them; the WP in each wp field flips pending=false when it ports the feature.

cases.note: Extended with cfilt: a series-tuned harmonic-filter bank (per-step R+XL) whose YPrim is a full series R+L+C branch off the pure-C diagonal at 60 Hz. Oracle-validated + feature-sensitive (dropping XL collapses it onto the pure-C stamp).

Boundaries: LineGeometry+WireData Carson full-asym Z/Yc (Line.pas geometry path, reduce=y Kron), 1-phase reduced spur, and the SymComponentsModel-only LongLineCorrection sinh(gamma*l)/(gamma*l) branch (Line.pas:1199/1369). Oracle: converged 5 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: LongLineCorrection yes->no changes Line.llong YPrim; swapping cond=1 wire changes Line.lgeo YPrim. Flipped oracle:capi015 at the upgrade-rung1 sync merge: `Set EarthModel=Carson` puts Get_Ze on the SimpleCarson branch that WP-U1.2 B2/D1 moved (De 658.5 -> 658.8530451057239, DIVERGENCES.md #b2--d1); vs 0.14.5 the deck diverges ~1.7e-3 (witnessed at merge), vs capi015 it is at the live floors.

Boundaries: CNData concentric-neutral and TSData tape-shield reduced-Y (distinct Kron neutral elimination CN vs TS), asymmetric underground burial. Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: CN strand count k 13->7 changes Line.lcn YPrim; TS TapeLayer 0.005->0.008 changes Line.lts YPrim. Flipped oracle:capi015 at the upgrade-rung1 sync merge: `Set EarthModel=Carson` -> SimpleCarson Get_Ze moved by WP-U1.2 B2/D1 (De 658.5 -> 658.8530451057239, DIVERGENCES.md #b2--d1).

WP-U1.2 D3 flip: the spacing path now derives NormAmps/EmergAmps as the MINIMUM over the PHASE conductors (LineGeometry.pas:1060-1064), so Line.lsp (wires ACSR_556/4-0/1-0, distinct ratings) moves 730/1095 -> 230/345 -- a 0.15.x observable the 0.14.5 oracle cannot match; flipped to oracle:capi015 (probed 2026-07-16, YPrim BIT-IDENTICAL 0.14.5==capi015 so the Carson stamp is unchanged, only the ratings move). Line.lspc is D3-invariant (165/247.5, the single tape-shield phase). Boundary: FMakeZFromSpacing (Line.pas:1183/1964) — the LineSpacing state machine, DISTINCT from the geometry path. lsp = overhead Spacing nconds=4 nphases=3 + distinct wires -> full-asym Carson Z/Yc via LoadSpacingAndWires + auto-reduce (NWires>NPhases, LineGeometry.pas:992); lspc = spacing+cable (TSCables+Wires) 1-phase spur, pins the spacing-with-cables sub-branch + gotRatingsAfterSpacingConds NormAmps/EmergAmps seed (Line.pas:1994). EarthModel DEFAULT (DERI) -> YPrim shares Get_Ze, so the 658.5->658.853 SimpleCarson move does NOT touch this deck (YPrim is bit-identical 0.14.5==capi015 -- the flip is ratings-only). Still a U1.4 default-path no-change anchor for the equivalent-spacing numerics (LineSpacing.Detailed/EqDist* default to the 0.14.5 detailed model). Oracle: converged 3 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: swapping the phase-2 wire ACSR_4-0->ACSR_556 changes Line.lsp YPrim.

Boundary: LongLineCorrection at f != BaseFrequency (Line.pas:1199-1287). Two SymComponentsModel long lines under Set LongLineCorrection=yes solved at the 5th harmonic (Set frequency=300, FreqMultiplier=5) -> per-frequency DoLongLine (X1_h=X1*f/base), the 0-seq DoLongLine sub-branch (FnPhases>1 and not PositiveSequence, r0<>r1), the LLC FreqMultiplier Z-assembly (:1269 vs :1287), and the LLC shunt-C branch (:1372). llh1 c1<>0; llh2 c1=0 (the G_h:=EPSILON no-skip case). Deviation from matrix P2 (mode=harmonics + monitor): a set-frequency snapshot with a DIRECT Line-YPrim compare is strictly stronger than the f32 harmonic monitor channel and needs no nonlinear-load-at-harmonic (linear shunt reactors, autotrans_gic pattern). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: LongLineCorrection yes->no changes both llh1/llh2 YPrims.

Boundary: Rg/Xg/Kxg ground-return frequency correction. Deck does NOT set LongLineCorrection (default FALSE), so it runs the non-LLC else branch (Line.pas:1281-1287), not the sibling LLC branch (:1262-1269); the two share the Xgmod formula but differ in the ZinvValues FreqMultiplier scaling. Explicit non-default Rg/Xg/rho solved at the 7th harmonic (Set frequency=420, FreqMultiplier=7). lgx (Xg<>0, Rg=0) fires the Xgmod=0.5*Kxg*ln(FreqMultiplier) branch; lgr (Rg<>0, Xg=0) fires the Rg*(FreqMultiplier-1) add — clean per-term isolation. WITNESSES the U1.2 inconsistency: Kxg deliberately KEEPS the 658.5 constant (upgrade ledger B2/D1) while SimpleCarson Get_Ze moves to 658.853; the SymComponentsModel path never calls Get_Ze, so this deck's YPrim must NOT move under U1.2 (INVARIANT regression, do NOT flip to capi015 — tracked in the upgrade ledger B2/D1, see the deck header). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: zeroing Rg/Xg (keeping f=420) changes both lgx/lgr YPrims.

Boundary: FullCarson EarthModel at SOLVE level (FLineConstants.Calc dispatch). Overhead geometry (reduce=y Kron, full-asym) under Set EarthModel=fullcarson — the only EarthModel with no prior live-solve deck (SimpleCarson=line_geometry/cable_asym, DERI=default). U1.2-INVARIANT control: U1.2 moves SimpleCarson Get_Ze 658.5->658.853 ONLY, FullCarson Get_Ze is unchanged, so this YPrim must NOT move (do NOT flip to capi015 — the complement of the Carson decks U1.2 flips). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: EarthModel fullcarson->Carson changes both lfc/lfcspur YPrims.

Hole 5: Line positive-sequence collapse at CONSTRUCTION (TLineObj.Create -> RecalcElementData reading the live ActiveCircuit.PositiveSequence, Line.pas:1001/1085). Set CktModel=Positive BEFORE `New Line.lctor` -> the default sequence impedances collapse R0:=R1/X0:=X1/C0:=C1 at create time; the r0/x0/c0 probes pin the readback (collapsed == r1/x1/c1) and the YPrim pins the effect, both channels. Oracle: converged; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: dropping `Set CktModel=Positive` keeps R0 0.1784 <> R1 0.058 (probe-proven 2026-07-25).

Hole 4: Line positive-sequence collapse at LINECODE FETCH (TLineObj.FetchLineCode -> RecalcElementData reading the live PositiveSequence, Line.pas:572/1085). Set CktModel=Positive BEFORE `linecode=lcps` -> the code's r1<>r0 data collapses at fetch time; the r0/x0/c0 probes pin the readback (0.1/0.2/3) both channels. Oracle: converged; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: dropping `Set CktModel=Positive` keeps R0 0.5 <> R1 0.1 (probe-proven 2026-07-25).

Hole 3: Line positive-sequence collapse at a PHASES EDIT (TLineObj.PropertySideEffects phases branch -> RecalcElementData reading the live PositiveSequence, Line.pas:628/1085). Line created 3-phase in a NON-PS circuit (R0 0.5 <> R1 0.1), solved, then CktModel flipped to Positive and `phases=2` edited -> the phases side effect collapses r0/x0/c0 AT EDIT TIME; the probes pin the readback (0.1/0.2/3) both channels. Oracle: converged; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: without the CktModel flip the phases edit leaves R0 0.5 <> R1 0.1 (probe-proven 2026-07-25).

Boundaries: wye-delta step-up (delta-lead +30deg phase shift, opposite of transformer_asym.tdy's delta-wye lag) and delta-delta (both terminals ungrounded, common mode held by ppm_antifloat + a small wye cap pin per the family floor rule). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: twd conns wye-delta->wye-wye changes both YPrims.

Hole 1: Set frequency=0.1 snapshot pinning Transformer GICBuildYTerminal (the Solution.Frequency < 0.51 Hz resistance-only Y_Term branch: 1/RdcOhms diagonal, NO inter-winding coupling, empty Y_Term_NL, ppm float adder as a real conductance) AND the Line GIC branch (ConvertZinvToPosSeqR, Line.pas:1297). Twin of autotrans/autotrans_gic.dss (Transformer instead of AutoTrans). Zero-current at 0.1 Hz so every YPrim pins at micro tier. Oracle: converged; bit-identical across 2 processes. Boundaries: Model 7 current-limited PQ (DoCurrentLimitedPQ clamp fires on the two phases sagged below Vminpu), Model 4 fixed-Q, Model 3 PV latched at a tight maxkvar. Oracle: converged 5 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: g7 model 7->1 changes the whole model (clamp active); g3 maxkvar 100->800 changes it (limit binding).

Boundaries (all wye-3ph): Storage IDLING state (Storage.pas:1410), PVSystem below %CutOut (P=0), PVSystem at the kvar clamp (tight kvarMax + WattPriority). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: idling->discharging, irradiance 0.05->0.9 (cutout), kvarMax 50->450 (clamp) each change the whole model.

Cross-element (midi): overhead Carson geometry -> CN cable -> delta-wye transformer -> unbalanced loads + TS 1-phase spur. Boundary: Carson/cable mutuals meet the transformer grounded-wye zero-sequence path across the assembled system Y (neutral-return coupling). Oracle: converged 3 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: adding a wdg-2 rneut/xneut ground impedance changes the whole-model fingerprint. Flipped oracle:capi015 at the upgrade-rung1 sync merge: `Set EarthModel=Carson` -> SimpleCarson Get_Ze moved by WP-U1.2 B2/D1 (De 658.5 -> 658.8530451057239, DIVERGENCES.md #b2--d1).

Load voltage-region state machine (Load.pas:1373/1433/1473/1658): a weak source + high-Z radial feeder sags far loads below Vminpu (interpolate_y95_ylow) and, at b3.2, below Vlowpu (const-Z Yeq), while a cap-boosted stub pushes bs above Vmaxpu (Yeq105 clamp). Models 1/3/5 (distinct interp paths) + 6/7 (yq_fixed) all fired off-normal. Oracle: converged 3 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. The 330 MVA YNad1 unit from Test/AutoTrans/AutoAuto.dss + a 2-winding 115/69 auto. Oracle wdgcurrents (probe 2026-07-05, t2 spot value): non-zero live recompute - the READS_VTERMINAL family. WPG.15 Stage B: live-green.

AutoTrans property 39 XfmrCode (AutoTrans.pas:329, FetchXfmrCode :2339-2396) — r4133-only, so engines=r4133: dss_capi 0.14.5 deleted the row (.inputs/dss_capi/src/PDElements/AutoTrans.pas:76,125) and would reject xfmrcode= as an unknown property. Both autos are SINGLE-PHASE on purpose: r4133's FetchXfmrCode sets NConds := Fnphases+1 (:2353, the Transformer's rule copy-pasted; every other AutoTrans path uses 2*Fnphases), which at nphases>1 leaves the oracle solving a structurally wrong element (measured 2026-08-22 on epri-worker: a 3-phase 115/69 auto reports NumConductors=4 and MID.1=92236 V on a 69 kV winding, vs 6 and 38472 V with a trailing phases=3). At one phase 1+1 == 2*1, so the port's correct rule and r4133's agree and the channel gates the whole copy. The XfmrCode declares both windings delta; the override forces wdg 1 SERIES / wdg 2 WYE (:2356-2361) and at one phase the wdg-1 half is strongly observable (VBase comes from kVseries = kVLL - Winding[2].kVLL). t1 is left on winding 2 and t2 on winding 1, so the same probe set reads both windings' copied values; the probes are limited to props r4133's GetPropertyValue overrides live (:1798-1896) and whose exact decimal fits %.7g — thermal/n/m/flrise/hsrise are PropertyValue echoes and normamps/emergamps are 5-significant-digit renders, so neither is probed. Live-validated on r4133 2026-08-22: converged, 5 iters, SOURCEBUS.1 114908.668456851403, MID1.1 66514.442565085992, SRC2.1 117228.327082133997, MID2.1 68431.041427177013.

Set frequency=0.1 snapshot - pins AutoTrans GICBuildYTerminal (the Solution.Frequency < 0.51 Hz resistance-only Y_Term branch) AND the Line GIC branch (ConvertZinvToPosSeqR, Line.pas:1297 - the near-ideal-source switch line is deliberate: at 0.1 Hz the deck state is zero-current, so no cancellation floor exists and every YPrim pins at micro tier). WPG.15: live-green.

Hole 2 edit path: AutoTrans EDITED (t2 wdg=2 rdcohms) between two Set frequency=0.1 solves. Exercises the recalc-at-GIC edit path (the executive-synced live frequency stays 0.1 Hz across the edit); the second solve rebuilds Y_Term from the new 1/RdcOhms. The Hole-2 recalc-path gate is itself observationally MASKED (CalcYPrim always rebuilds Y_Term at the solve frequency), so this deck pins the AutoTrans edit-at-GIC path, not the intermediate gate. Oracle: converged; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: t2 wdg=2 rdcohms changes the AutoTrans YPrim diagonal.

GOLDEN_REBASE G1.4a (2026-09-04, coordinator decision D12): gated on r4133 ONLY. The pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 oracle disagrees with ITSELF across fresh processes on any deck that instantiates a GICTransformer -- 7 bad runs of 60 with the element, 0 of 40 without; the whole no-load solve lands elsewhere and Bus.kVBase is punted to 0. EPRI r4133 is deterministic (80/80 bit-identical over 20 one-shot runs x 4 decks), and an oracle channel that disagrees with itself cannot gate (CLAUDE.md: prefer the r4133 channel). See DIVERGENCES.md D12/D14.

The bus2 probes pin the GICsource edit-time splice: the oracle rewrites the named Line's Bus2 to the inserted GIC_<name> bus (proven 2026-07-05: buses gic_seg12/gic_seg23 appear; line.seg12.bus2 = gic_seg12).

All three GIC classes chained on a 6-substation 345 kV ring (33 nodes); the bus2 probes pin the GICsource splices. No async/both variants: the GIC classes have no shape reference or time-varying drive upstream.
